items.title: 喜报！AES100发动机获唯一特等奖
items.excerpt: AECC reports six aerospace technology awards, covering the AES100 1,000-kW civil turboshaft; additive manufacturing of high-temperature complex thin-wall engine parts; blade-clearance and axial-transient measurement; turbine aero-thermal design; cooled combustor design; and low-density sealants.

items.title: 央广网报道丨从蓝天到能源重器：国产燃气轮机自主攻关之路
items.excerpt: AECC's dated report describes aero-derived Taihang turbine advances in hot-section life, stable low-emission combustion, dual-fuel switching and domestic controls. Taihang7 units have accumulated over 90,000 operating hours in offshore service; AECC describes an integrated 1–110 MW product platform.

items.title: Airbus A350F freighter successfully performs its maiden flight
items.excerpt: A350F MSN700 completed a 4h10 first flight to 25,000 ft, beginning certification testing. The accompanying engineering account explains predictive-model validation, transition from direct to normal control law, and an FTI system recording thousands of parameters with real-time telemetry.

items.title: Countdown to A350F first flight: Preparing for the sky
items.excerpt: Airbus describes 13 virtual-flight sessions using a simulator connected to real avionics, flight controls and engine-control test benches. The freighter's distinct aerodynamic model needs validation, with anemometry calibration, smoke detection tests and redesigned flight-test instrumentation supporting the campaign.

items.title: Airbus invests into UK manufacturing to support global production ramp-up
items.excerpt: Airbus is converting Broughton's former A380 wing factory into an A321 production line with six wing jigs, an equipping line and a paint shop. The first wing is underway; all jigs are expected operational by year-end. Operators contributed to ergonomics and technology integration.

items.title: Shaping the future of flight testing
items.excerpt: Airbus and France's DGA jointly modified a civil H160 with a dedicated rear-cabin flight-test system for EPNER. The installation expands training in performance, handling and onboard-system testing, while predictive maintenance analytics support technician training.

items.title: Airbus strengthens A320 Family delivery capacity in Toulouse with a new delivery centre
items.excerpt: Airbus opened an integrated Toulouse delivery centre exceeding 35,000 m², with 16 aircraft positions near final assembly and a dedicated technical-adjustment and finishing hall. Co-locating these stages is intended to streamline industrial flows and support A320-family production ramp-up.

items.title: Airbus delivers first aircraft from its second A320 Family Final Assembly Line in China
items.excerpt: Airbus delivered the first A320neo assembled on its second Tianjin final-assembly line to China Eastern. This validates an added production line in the ten-line A320 global assembly network, supporting the rate-75 ramp-up strategy.

items.title: Partnership between ORNL, Boeing advances manufacturing for aircraft parts
items.excerpt: ORNL and Boeing produced a nearly two-ton steel stamp-form die using wire-arc additive manufacturing. The tool supports thermoplastic composite aircraft-part production for NASA HiCAM, with industrial partners contributing printing and final processing.

items.title: Boeing, American Airlines Complete First 737 MAX Landing Gear Exchange
items.excerpt: The first 737 MAX landing-gear exchange validated an end-to-end overhaul, certification and ready-to-install delivery process. Boeing is expanding MAX-capable inventory and certified MRO partner capacity to reduce aircraft downtime.

items.title: Boeing Secures Order For First Full-Rate Production Grey Wolf Helicopters
items.excerpt: MH-139A Grey Wolf moved into full-rate production after reaching initial operational capability. The first full-rate award covers four aircraft; Boeing reports 42 under contract and 27 delivered.

items.title: U.S. Navy Selects Boeing for F/A-XX Program
items.excerpt: Boeing was selected to design and build the Navy's sixth-generation fighter. The release identifies open mission-system architecture and an all-digital design/manufacturing system under construction in St. Louis; detailed specifications remain classified.

items.title: Satellite constellation set to level up service
items.excerpt: Launch of the final three O3b mPOWER spacecraft completed the 13-satellite constellation. Boeing describes software-defined bandwidth routing and a scalable 702X architecture serving as a technical baseline for hardened government satellites.

items.title: Lockheed Martin Announces First Flight of Morocco’s First F 16 Block 72
items.excerpt: Morocco's first F-16 Block 72 completed its first flight and entered flight testing toward delivery. The aircraft integrates updated avionics, sensors and mission systems; the release also outlines planned Moroccan MRO capacity.

items.title: Lockheed Martin Connects F-35 Crews Across Multiple Locations for Live Mission Rehearsal
items.excerpt: A two-hour distributed training event linked 16 F-35 full-mission simulators across four bases with F-18 simulators and an E-2D controller. Lockheed reports uninterrupted data exchange and successful integration across the geographically separated sites.

items.title: Lockheed Martin Fast-Tracks PAC-3 MSE Components in Less Than One Month in Partnership with GM Defense
items.excerpt: GM Defense delivered initial housing components 22 days after its contract, using commercial casting and precision machining to meet defense specifications. The publication reports an August delivery milestone and demonstrates cross-industry production transfer.

items.title: Lockheed Martin Demonstrates Legion Sensor System with Pod-to-Pod Data Link
items.excerpt: Two F-16s flight-tested Legion infrared sensor pods with L3Harris HiveLink. The pods exchanged data and improved track accuracy, demonstrating networked passive sensing and the sensor system's modular open architecture.

items.title: Lockheed Martin Secures U.S. Space Force Contracts to Further Modernize the GPS Ground Segment
items.excerpt: New work upgrades the GPS ground system to control GPS IIIF payloads and begins a three-phase x86 hardware/software refresh. The modular modernization supports next-generation satellites and resilient positioning, navigation and timing.

items.title: BAE Systems receives $16 million to qualify RH45 technology for radiation-hardened space missions
items.excerpt: BAE will demonstrate and qualify radiation-hardened 45nm technology using GlobalFoundries' Malta, New York SOI process. The effort reestablishes an ASIC design storefront and qualified building blocks for custom space electronics.
items.query: BAE Systems US homepage technical links

items.title: BAE Systems completes successful Critical Design Review for U.S. Space Force missile warning and tracking program
items.excerpt: MEO Epoch 2 passed critical design review 14 months after award. Digital modeling, simulation and model-based systems engineering supported the 10-spacecraft design and early component production using the Trek bus and infrared payload heritage.
items.query: BAE Systems US homepage technical links

items.title: BAE Systems to deliver M-Code GPS for U.S. Navy joint precision approach and landing system
items.excerpt: BAE will develop a DIGAR-500M-based M-Code upgrade for Collins Aerospace's carrier landing system. Dual SAASM/M-Code operation and digital beamforming improve resilience while supporting mixed aircraft configurations.
items.query: BAE Systems US homepage technical links

items.title: Northrop Grumman Opens New Manufacturing Facility in Layton, Utah
items.excerpt: Northrop opened East Gate 3 in Layton, Utah, ahead of schedule to expand B-21 manufacturing. The broader East Gate campus is planned to total about 845,000 square feet, supporting aircraft production scaling.

items.title: Delivering electronic warfare systems for F-35 stealth fighters
items.excerpt: BAE will produce AN/ASQ-239 systems for F-35 Lots 20–22 and retrofit older aircraft. The release identifies automation, updated designs and facility investment to accelerate output, plus software-updatable sensing and processing.
items.query: BAE Systems US homepage technical links

items.title: CEO: 737-10 certification very soon, more to do to stabilize production
items.excerpt: Boeing reports completion of 737-10 flight testing, with certification documentation remaining. Production is targeting 47 monthly 737s but is not yet stable; 787 output is stable at eight, with a second assembly facility under construction.

items.title: Boeing secures order for 22 more F-15EX fighters
items.excerpt: The announcement reports delivery of the first Lot 3 F-15EX and ongoing work to raise output to two aircraft monthly. The new award covers 22 aircraft and completes contracting for production Lots 1–7.

items.title: Driving Innovation: Lockheed Martin’s PAC-3 MSE Partnerships
items.excerpt: Polish offset partnerships include a PGZ hardware-in-the-loop demonstration and August orders for WZE launcher electronic stations and junction-box units. The dated report describes manufacturing transfer and supplier qualification milestones.

items.title: Flow Engineering raises $50M Series B for agentic hardware systems engineering
items.excerpt: Flow announced $50M Series B at $750M valuation. Its agents connect requirements, CAD, simulation, code and tests; plans include review, branching and evaluation controls. Rivian usage grew from 40 to 1,500 users in seven months, per company. Discovery: traceable systems-engineering workflow is worth monitoring; cycle-time gains are aspirations.

items.title: AMFlexInj validates additively manufactured fuel-flexible gas-turbine injectors
items.excerpt: Stuttgart and DLR report lab-tested printed injectors tolerant of surface roughness and suitable for varied fuels. AMFlexInj receives €1.5M through2029 for geometry/process optimization and real-condition prototype tests. Discovery: university–DLR work links combustion design, fuel flexibility and manufacturing; no field validation yet.

items.title: SOSV HAX backs Zenithon's $10M seed round for extreme-physics world models
items.category: scientific AI・シミュレーション
items.excerpt: Investor HAX confirms participating in Zenithon's $10M seed round for plasma world models targeting fusion, semiconductor manufacturing and aerospace. Million-fold speed claims are investor-reported without disclosed benchmark controls. Discovery: extreme-physics surrogates and targeted experimental data generation merit continued validation monitoring.

items.title: Vinci raises $250M to expand continuous physics reasoning beyond semiconductors
items.excerpt: Vinci announced $250M Series B at $1.5B valuation. It reports zero-shot thermal, thermo-mechanical and convective-fluid analysis combining agents, a physics model and GPU kernels; >15bn-DOF runs in minutes are vendor claims. Discovery: expansion toward aircraft and multi-physics engineering merits monitoring; aerospace deployment is not established.
